text: Security is a key part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data between users and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or two-factor login. Input validation is also important because it stops harmful data from entering the system. Developers must understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and take steps to prevent them. By focusing on these areas, developers can build safer websites and protect both user information and company data.
